# API reference

All SDK methods use lowerCamelCase. Native Roblox APIs keep engine casing.

Types are available from the named source/Roblox module; `Types/*` is the public wire-contract namespace.
Underscore members and module constructors other than `BloxSDK.new` are private implementation details.

export type Page<T> = {
	content: { T },
	number: number,
	size: number,

	last: boolean,
	empty: boolean?,

}

export type Aggregation = "BEST" | "SUM" | "LAST" | "MIN" | "MAX"

export type Board = {
	aggregation: (Aggregation | Core.Null)?,
	archived: boolean,
	createdAt: (string | Core.Null)?,
	currentPeriodId: (string | Core.Null)?,
	displayName: (string | Core.Null)?,
	id: (string | Core.Null)?,
	maxDeltaPerSubmit: (number | Core.Null)?,
	maxScore: number,
	minScore: number,
	name: (string | Core.Null)?,
	periodStartedAt: (string | Core.Null)?,
	resetSchedule: (ResetSchedule | Core.Null)?,
	sortOrder: (SortOrder | Core.Null)?,
	universeId: number,
}

export type CreateBoard = {
	aggregation: Aggregation?,
	displayName: string,
	maxDeltaPerSubmit: number?,
	maxScore: number?,
	minScore: number?,
	name: string?,
	resetSchedule: ResetSchedule?,
	sortOrder: SortOrder?,
	universeId: number?,
}

export type HealthResponse = Core.HealthResponse

	aggregation: Aggregation?,

	sortOrder: SortOrder?,

}

}

}

export type RatingConfig = { floor: number, initialRating: number, kFactor: number, universeId: number? }

}
